tableDependencies.usage: Team 03 reads and creates admin_approval gates via commercialGateService. Approval state machine is NOT duplicated — ai_commercial_gates is the single source of truth. Requires gate_type='admin_approval' support (already present in schema).
Read-only via raw SQL. NOT added by Team 03. Attribution and funnel projection read utm_source, customer_id, event_type from this table.
tableDependencies.mustExistBefore: funnel/attribution endpoints to return non-empty data

tableDependencies.usage: Used for tenant-scoped filtering (WHERE tenant_id = ?) in attribution/funnel aggregate queries. Also used for customer_email → profile_id joins in repeat-order service.
Read-only. couponRecommendationService reads active coupons for scoring. Does NOT create or modify coupons — creation is gated through admin_approval flow.
tableDependencies.overlapNote: Route overlap with ai-coupons team: GET /ai/creative-commercial/recommendations/:id/coupon READS ai_coupons; POST /approvals/request-coupon creates a GATE to request coupon issuance. The gate approval publishes commercial.approval.granted — downstream handler (not Team 03) performs the actual coupon creation.

tableDependencies.usage: Read-only. bundlingService references promotions for pricing context. Does NOT create promotions.
tableDependencies.overlapNote: Route overlap with ai-promotions: Team 03 exposes /ai/creative-commercial/bundles which reads bundle templates from static code (not ai_promotions). No writes to ai_promotions. Teams should coordinate to avoid returning conflicting bundle/promotion recommendations to the same customer.

routeOverlaps.overlapType: READ overlap — both may expose coupon recommendations for a customer
routeOverlaps.resolution: Team 03 is a pure read aggregator. The actual coupon issuance goes through ai_commercial_gates (approval required for >X% discount). Team 03 does NOT write to ai_coupons.

routeOverlaps.overlapType: SEMANTIC overlap — both expose 'bundle' or 'promotion' concepts
routeOverlaps.resolution: Team 03 bundles are static templates defined in bundlingService.ts (5 hardcoded templates). They are NOT backed by ai_promotions rows. If ai-promotions team creates a dynamic bundle system, Team 03 should replace its static templates with reads from that system.

routeOverlaps.overlapType: WRITE GATE — Team 03 creates an admin_approval gate; the approval event triggers coupon creation by downstream handler
routeOverlaps.resolution: Team 03 never directly inserts into ai_coupons. The commercial.approval.granted event payload includes actionType='issue_recovery_coupon' and all required fields. The coupon team's event handler performs the actual insert. Both teams must agree on the event payload schema.

routeOverlaps.overlapType: READ overlap — reads the same sales_funnel_events table
routeOverlaps.resolution: Team 03's funnel projection is a derived read model for commercial automation context (upsell triggers, abandonment detection). It is NOT a replacement for the primary funnel analytics dashboard. Tenant-scoped by query param.

eventsPublished.comment: Published when a pending admin_approval gate is verified. Downstream handlers should check actionType and execute the actual financial action (e.g. issue coupon, apply bundle price). Team 03 does NOT execute the action itself.

auditRemediationLog.evidence: git log --oneline main -- lib/db/src/schema/sales-funnel-events.ts → commit 3a821a1 (pre-existing in main). git diff main...HEAD --name-only → file not in Team 03 diff.
auditRemediationLog.action: Removed unused Drizzle ORM table imports (salesFunnelEventsTable, aiServiceRequestsTable) from attributionService.ts. All queries use raw SQL db.execute() only.

Removed cc_pending_approvals table from migration draft. Rewrote approvalService.ts as an adapter over ai_commercial_gates (gate_type='admin_approval'). Uses verifyGate()/failGate() from existing commercialGateService. Idempotent: (customerProfileId, actionType) pair checked before insert.

auditRemediationLog.finding: P1 — RBAC / tenant scope on aggregate endpoints
auditRemediationLog.action: getAttributionReport() and buildFunnelMetrics() now accept optional tenantId parameter. Routes pass ?tenantId= query param through. Tenant filter applied via subquery on customer_profiles.tenant_id. Per-customer endpoints (attribution/:customerProfileId, recommendations/:customerProfileId) are already scoped by ID. Route docs updated.

auditRemediationLog.finding: P1 — Missing auth on attribution/funnel/recommendation routes
auditRemediationLog.action: Explicit router.use(adminAuth) applied in routes/creative-commercial/index.ts. Belt-and-suspenders over global adminAuthWithExceptions mount.

knownRisks.mitigation: Add a periodic cleanup job (delete rows where cooldown_until < now() - 30 days). Team 24 or Team 6 (scheduler) can add this as a cron rule.

knownRisks.risk: Funnel event type strings are not validated at insert time
knownRisks.mitigation: cc_funnel_snapshots CASE expression will simply ignore unknown event types — silently returns zero for unknown stages. Not a correctness risk, just visibility.

knownRisks.risk: Attribution touchpoints are inferred from UTM params, which can be spoofed
knownRisks.mitigation: Attribution is a READ MODEL only — no financial decisions are made solely based on it. It is advisory for marketing analysis.

knownRisks.risk: Bundle price is a recommendation, not enforced in the payment system
knownRisks.mitigation: bundle.requiresApproval=true for >20% discount. Approval triggers commercial.approval.granted event; downstream payment/quotation system applies the actual discount.

knownRisks.risk: COOLDOWN_HOURS values are hardcoded in types.ts
knownRisks.mitigation: Move to ai_settings table for operator configurability in a follow-up. Not required for MVP.

knownRisks.risk: Platform-wide admin view (tenantId not provided) exposes all tenants' data
knownRisks.mitigation: Aggregate endpoints (attribution/report, funnel/projection) are behind adminAuth. Platform-wide view is intentional for super-admin. Operators should provide tenantId when scoping to a specific tenant.

knownRisks.risk: ai_commercial_gates notes column is TEXT (JSON stored as string, not JSONB)
knownRisks.mitigation: approvalService uses JSONB operators (notes->>'key') in raw SQL which works on text-cast-to-jsonb. If Postgres rejects the cast, add CAST(notes AS jsonb) explicitly. Team 24 may need to ALTER COLUMN notes TYPE JSONB if query performance degrades.
